name: Google Classroom
summary: A classroom management and learning workflow service within Google Workspace for Education, supporting assignment distribution, feedback, communication and class organisation.

value: SIS roster sync and third-party education apps

value.notes: Education Fundamentals is free for qualifying institutions; paid Workspace for Education editions are priced per licence.

accessibility.finding: Google publishes Workspace accessibility documentation; obtain Classroom-specific ACR/VPAT and verify whether all Classroom surfaces/apps are covered.
accessibility.caveat: Workspace-level accessibility materials may not cover Classroom in full.
